digest_spec.input_hash: caller-supplied 64-hex digest; its content domain is frozen by the admission and prepare tasks, not by this fixture
digest_spec.application_input_hash_domain: unchanged P2 domain (frozen pair, manifest hash, mode, purpose); authorization is excluded

rule_review_coverage_rule: every manifest entry with an open issue, a closure proposal, a critical effect, or unbound_new status must have one rule_reviews item keyed by its application_ref; resolved_with_closure must carry the exact proposal_hash; other dispositions must not carry one

capacity_profile.overflow: explicit scan_capped plus note or admission-time rejection; never silent truncation and never treated as no change

switch_matrix.all_off: every P3 write path disabled; reads and legacy behavior byte-identical to current
switch_matrix.supplemental_only_on: new company_research/review admissions bind; admission-time switch state decides binding forever; old tasks stay legacy_unbound
switch_matrix.fit_combinations: account_fit and candidate_ranking paths take the intersection with their own switches
switch_matrix.published_reads: limit checks on already published conclusions ignore the switches

storage_shapes.rule_coverage_row: account NULL, listing NOT NULL, entry_count >= 0, manifest_hash NOT NULL, universe NULL, series columns NULL
storage_shapes.research_rule_binding_row: PK(id,revision), task_id UNIQUE, immutable via SQL triggers, revision=1
